title: SDK docs scratchpad - sample apps & tutorial fixes
content:
Quick context:
- Personal scratchpad for small SDK docs work, sample apps and tutorial fixes. Mostly todo list + notes to self.
- Goal: get 3x lightweight tutorial flows that a user can complete in <15min (chat, embeddings+search, function calling).

Top priorities (short term):
- [ ] Finalize chat tutorial (basic->streaming->tools) — needs updated code snippets for streaming API change (client.streamChat -> client.chat.stream).
    - blocking: verify Python example still works with token iterator (see PR #472).
    - assign to: Priya for python, Daniel for JS.
- [ ] Create a one-page starter app using Vite + Redwood SDK that demonstrates: chat + embeddings + simple rerank. Keep under 200 LOC.
    - rough steps: template repo, README, 3 screenshots, deploy instructions with Hosted API key env var.
- [ ] Update embedding tutorial to show batching + caching tips from Optimize team notes (incorporate sample batching util).

Open issues / doc gaps:
- function-calling docs inconsistent: some examples use 'functions' array, others use 'tools' with different param shapes. Need canonical pattern + migration note.
- streaming vs non-streaming API surfaces: we mention both but not when to pick which. Add a small decision table (latency vs simplicity).
- missing TS types for new response format in SDK v0.9.3 (reported by Samir). File issue in SDK repo.

Sample app ideas (quick brainstorm):
- "Redwood Helpdesk" minimal app: upload docs -> embeddings -> similarity search -> chat assistant that cites docs. (good customer-facing reference).
- "Code explainer": paste code -> generate embeddings per chunk -> chat UI that can run small code-search queries + openAI-style explainers.
- "Realtime pair-programmer": stream completions into editor iframe (proof-of-concept only).

Tutorial fixes checklist (concrete):
- Chat tutorial:
    - replace deprecated client.chat.create calls with client.chat.createConversation (note: confirm signature).
    - add streaming example and explain memory usage + how to cancel stream.
- Embeddings:
    - add example of batching 1000 texts into chunks of 100 with concurrency 4.
    - show caching snippet using LRU cache code (link to examples repo).
- Function calling:
    - standardize on JSON-schema style param descriptions. Add example of fallback when function fails.

Notes to self / small commands:
- Local test: run examples/chatbot-sample with ENV=HOSTED_KEY and verify streaming for both Python and JS.
- Create PR template for docs changes that includes: steps to test, sample request/response, before/after screenshots.
- Follow up with Optimize team: get suggested batching settings for small-medium workloads (email Priya).

Timeline / milestones:
- By 2026-02-28: land basic chat tutorial + starter app repo (MVP).
- By 2026-03-10: finalize embeddings tutorial + function-calling canonical page.

Personal log (quick):
- 2026-01-05: hacked on streaming example; hit TS type mismatch, filed note to Samir.
- 2026-01-20: demo'd starter app idea to DX sync; received request to add deploy button to Netlify.
- 2026-02-15: got feedback from beta users: they want simpler authentication flow in README (env var vs config file).

Misc snippets to add later:
- Minimal batching util (pseudo):
    async function batchProcess(items, batchSize, handler) {
      for (let i=0; i<items.length; i += batchSize) {
        await Promise.all(items.slice(i, i+batchSize).map(handler));
      }
    }
- Example streaming cancellation note: "store stream handle, call handle.cancel() on navigation or user abort"

Next immediate actions (today):
- Pull latest SDK changes and run python streaming example locally (30m).
- Draft PR for chat tutorial edits (start with python snippets).
- Ping Samir on TS types and attach failing compile log.

Questions / decisions pending:
- Do we prefer 'tools' or 'functions' naming in tutorials (ask API team).
- Should starter app include server-side component for API key proxy? (customer-security asked for guidance)

Random todos (low priority):
- Add short checklist for security review of sample apps (avoid embedding real keys).
- Add quick FAQ section: rate limits, cost estimate for sample apps, troubleshooting streaming.

--
End of scratchpad. Keep informal. Will convert to formal PR checklist once basic examples pass tests.
